title: Largest Jump
statement: An array records a runner's position after each second. Return the largest distance travelled in a single second: the largest absolute difference between two neighbouring values. Return 0 if there are fewer than two values.

answerKey.pattern: Single scan over neighbouring pairs keeping the largest absolute difference
keyPoints: Visit each neighbouring pair once (i - 1, i)
Use the absolute value of the difference
Keep the largest difference, starting from 0
edgeCases: Moves backwards need the absolute value
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Compare every pair of positions: O(n^2), and wrong because only neighbours count

hints: Only neighbouring values matter. How many neighbouring pairs are there?
Walk once through the array and compare each value with the one before it.
A move backwards is still a distance: use the absolute difference.
